verdict.rationale: Elastic docs mention 'official skills that teach AI coding agents how to work with Elasticsearch' (elastic-docs-10), suggesting some agent-oriented documentation exists, but direct probes confirm no llms.txt or docs.md file is served (elastic-probe-1, elastic-probe-2), and no OpenAPI spec is exposed either (elastic-probe-3). missing for 10: a dedicated llms.txt or machine-readable agent doc index, confirmation of what the 'skills' artifact actually contains/format, and any independent verification an agent can consume it directly.
